lines: That remark had all the strength of loose gravel.
I have swept up gravel with firmer opinions than that.
If that thought were mortar, the wall would already be down.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken stonework with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
Your words carry weight, but not the useful kind.
You brought heavy talk and no foundation under it.
That kind of weight cracks floors, not arguments.
